subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicit `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` fail startup whenever the Tailscale listener cannot be established, even though existing installations may currently fall back to loopback?
rationale: The current behavior favors availability but silently changes an explicit network-boundary choice; changing it is security-aligned yet upgrade-sensitive and therefore requires gateway/security owner intent.

options.title: Fail explicit tailnet closed
options.body: Return a clear startup error for missing or unusable Tailscale addresses while leaving `auto` and explicitly selected loopback modes unchanged.

options.title: Preserve fallback with warning
options.body: Keep loopback availability but emit a prominent diagnostic that the configured tailnet boundary was not established.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit tailnet closed
recommendation.body: Return a clear startup error for missing or unusable Tailscale addresses while leaving `auto` and explicitly selected loopback modes unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the current bind-resolution and startup-check surfaces.
